name: Rooftop
look: Tar and rain. A rooftop access door leads down to the top floor. Vents tick. A water tank keeps the skyline company. The ladder Charlie climbed is still behind him.

hotspots.look: A rooftop access door. The lock is a pin tumbler, and it is locked.
Sheet-metal vents, ticking as the rain finds them. They do not open, and they do not lead down.
A water tank on stilts, black against the wet sky. No door in it. The way down is the access door.
The fire-escape ladder, slick and still down. The thug is somewhere under it. Down is the wrong direction.

effects.text: Thanks to Uncle John, who thought lock-picking lessons were a fine Christmas present for a teenager, the lock gives in seconds.
Charlie takes the stairs down through a dark top floor, crosses a lobby that is trying to look empty, and comes out under the awning.
